title: cantileverBeam
body:
## cantileverBeam

Assess a rectangular structural member under six signed end resultants: axial force, biaxial bending forces, end torque and biaxial bending couples. Inputs describe physical intent and serviceability, while Schemaxis generates quadratic solid meshes and independently checks axial/Euler-Bernoulli/Prandtl theory, support equilibrium, separate refinement and exact saved-deck readback. Clamped members permit combined loads; axialSlide permits only axial loads while allowing Poisson contraction. Outputs are beam.inp, interior-stress.csv and beam-assessment.json. Choose this for bounded linear elastic stiffness and sampled-stress studies.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only one straight solid rectangular section family; no arbitrary meshes/decks, nonlinearity, buckling, thermal, modal, contact or failure analysis.
- Interior sampled stress excludes the clamp/loaded end and does not bound peak stress or certify yielding.
- Cancelling forces/couples can yield almost zero translation with nonzero stress; absolute-contribution scales preserve numerical checks.
- A numerically valid solve can fail explicit serviceability requirements.

Native binding: `CalculiX C3D20R linear static`. Output kind: `["table","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beam` | Straight solid rectangular geometry in metres. The member spans x=0 to x=length; its section is centred on y=z=0. Width is along y and height along z. Only rectangular solid sections are supported; changing either dimension also changes axial and torsional stiffness. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"length_m":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0.001,"maximum":10},"width_m":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":1e-05,"maximum":1},"height_m":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":1e-05,"maximum":1}}}` | **required** |
| `material` | Uniform isotropic linear elastic material defined by Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio. There is no yield law, temperature dependence, damage or failure assessment. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"youngsModulus_Pa":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":1000000.0,"maximum":1000000000000.0},"poissonRatio":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0,"maximum":0.35}}}` | **required** |
| `load` | Six global end-face resultants, with omitted components defaulting to zero: forces in N and moments in N m. Transverse forces, axial force and end couples can be superposed for clamped members. Right-hand-rule moments are distributed consistent face tractions; solid nodes have no rotational degrees of freedom. Equal/opposite contributions may cancel tip translation but still produce stress. At least one force or moment/length must reach 0.01 N. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"tipForceX_N":{"type":"number","default":0,"minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"tipForceY_N":{"type":"number","default":0,"minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"tipForceZ_N":{"type":"number","default":0,"minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"tipMomentX_Nm":{"type":"number","default":0,"minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"tipMomentY_Nm":{"type":"number","default":0,"minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"tipMomentZ_Nm":{"type":"number","default":0,"minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0}}}` | **required** |
| `support` | clamped (default) fixes all translations of the x=0 face and accepts all six resultants. axialSlide fixes axial translation there and restrains transverse motion only along the section symmetry lines, permitting uniform Poisson contraction. axialSlide accepts only a nonzero axial force; it is not a simply-supported bending or arbitrary roller model. | `{"type":"enum","values":["clamped","axialSlide"]}` | `"clamped"` |
| `mesh` | Base resolution of the quadratic 20-node brick mesh. The second mesh doubles axial cells and the fine mesh doubles all directions. Every active translation and twist must change by at most 1% of its absolute-contribution theory scale on each independent refinement; fine responses must agree within 3% of theory. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"lengthCells":{"type":"integer","minimum":12,"maximum":24,"default":12},"sectionCells":{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":3,"default":2}}}` | `{"lengthCells":12,"sectionCells":2}` |
| `requirements` | Up to 16 uniquely named upper limits on actual native measurements. Translation components/magnitude, torsional twist and interior sampled normal/von Mises stress are available. Omission means no user limit, while independent numerical acceptance still applies. An unmet limit retains measured margins but blocks publication and workflow reuse. | `{"type":"array","maxItems":16,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64,"required":true},"quantity":{"type":"enum","values":["absTipAreaMeanUx_m","absTipAreaMeanUy_m","absTipAreaMeanUz_m","tipAreaMeanTranslation_m","absTipTwist_rad","maxInteriorSampleNormalStress_Pa","maxInteriorSampleVonMises_Pa"],"required":true},"maximum":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0,"maximum":1000000000000.0}}}}` | `[]` |
